destination.title: Inflationary models under conjectural restrictions
destination.question: Which field regions, branches and parameter choices meet the source-specified quantum-gravity conjectures, and how do those choices compare with the cited inflationary observations?
destination.summary: A shared compatibility question accommodates distinct models and distinct conjectures. Adjustable parameters, universal constants, field-domain coverage and observational agreement must be assessed separately.

targets: Applicability and interpretation of conjectural tests
regimes: The inflationary branch and approximations specified by each source
assumptions: Original, refined, further-refined, distance, censorship and scalar weak-gravity conditions remain separate.
Passing a chosen condition does not establish a quantum-gravity completion.
conventions: Preserve derivative prescriptions and potential normalization.
Do not infer one universal parameter choice from separate model-wise choices.
includes: Negative results and unresolved applicability questions

sources.title: Minimal gauge inflation and the refined Swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Determine whether minimal gauge inflation can obey the refined de Sitter disjunction across its selected field branch and fit the quoted CMB inputs, thereby restricting the unknown universal constants c1 and c2.

sources.title: Type I Hilltop Inflation and the Refined Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Can a small field hilltop model fit CMB observables and satisfy the refined de Sitter conjecture? The comparison concerns conventional slow-roll dynamics and modified dynamics on a brane, while keeping potential curvature distinct from the dynamical slow-roll parameter.

sources.title: Higgs Inflation and the Refined dS Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the Higgs act as the inflaton while its potential satisfies the refined de Sitter conjecture throughout the field interval needed for inflation? The paper asks which conjecture constants permit this and whether observations exclude that region.

sources.title: Reheating constraints on the inflaton and dark matter: Swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Can varying the shape scale of a supergravity-inspired plateau maintain observational agreement while bringing the conjecture parameters toward order unity?

sources.title: Primordial black hole tower: Dark matter, earth-mass, and LIGO black holes

evidence.text: Can positive-potential inflation satisfy the field-space restrictions conjectured for effective theories admitting quantum-gravity completion?

sources.title: Inflation, swampland and landscape

evidence.text: Can string-inspired tip inflation satisfy the alternative gradient and curvature conditions of the refined de Sitter conjecture, and which parameter regions do the authors identify as compatible with inflationary observations?

sources.title: Higgs inflation and its extensions and the further refining dS swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Can metric Higgs inflation, Palatini Higgs inflation, and Higgs–Dilaton inflation satisfy the further-refined de Sitter conjecture through suitable choices of its parameters, despite reported tension with the earlier refined conjecture?

sources.title: Palatini Higgs inflation and the refined dS conjecture

evidence.text: Can the positive inflationary plateau of Palatini Higgs inflation satisfy either branch of the refined de Sitter conjecture with positive order-one constants, while remaining compatible with the quoted cosmological constraints and its assumed inflationary regime?

sources.title: Scalar Weak Gravity Conjecture in Super Yang-Mills Inflationary Model

evidence.text: Which field regions of four composite inflation potentials satisfy both scalar weak-gravity inequalities, alongside previously reported further-refined de Sitter compatibility?

sources.title: Minimal gauge inflation and the refined Swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Use the spectral tilt to infer the inverse decay scale, eliminate the e-fold exponential through the tensor ratio, and solve for the amplitude and e-fold count. The procedure propagates rather than independently checks its input approximations.

sources.title: Type I Hilltop Inflation and the Refined Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Agent reconstruction matches coefficients in the supplied equations and redefines the curvature and endpoint variables together. It corrects the factor-of-two mismatch under fixed physical derivatives, conditional on dimensional restoration and two independent asymptotic approximations.

sources.title: Higgs Inflation and the Refined dS Conjecture

evidence.text: Find the field subsets satisfying each branch, compare their endpoints, and convert overlap and endpoint conditions into parameter inequalities. The paper applies this operation to the Higgs potential's decreasing slope ratio and nonmonotonic curvature ratio.

sources.title: Reheating constraints on the inflaton and dark matter: Swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Map an inflationary solution to a reheating history by matching the pivot scale to today's thermal scale. Impose nonnegative duration and a completion-temperature floor within the constant-equation-of-state approximation.

sources.title: Primordial black hole tower: Dark matter, earth-mass, and LIGO black holes

evidence.text: For an isolated exponentially sharp Gaussian-curvature peak, construct the typical profile, find maximal compaction, select the regular threshold branch, and estimate a peak abundance and mass.

sources.title: Inflation, swampland and landscape

evidence.text: Dimensionless functions F and G encode the potential slope and curvature. Their crossings with conjecture thresholds define φ• and φ‡; the authors combine these crossings and plot critical curves in the (c1,c2) plane for different µ/Mpl.

sources.title: Swampland Constraints on No-Boundary Quantum Cosmology

evidence.text: Can the traditional Hartle–Hawking state give appreciable relative weight to classical inflationary universes when Einstein gravity with a scalar field obeys the assumed distance and refined de Sitter conjectures?

sources.title: Is curvature-assisted quintessence observationally viable?

evidence.text: Can negative spatial curvature make steep, single-field exponential quintessence compatible with cosmological observations and the strong de Sitter conjecture? Inflation is considered through a secondary qualitative argument.

sources.title: Gauss–Bonnet Inflation and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Do the adopted quantum-gravity conjectures point toward a particular curvature coupling in inflation?

sources.title: A Solution to the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture versus Inflation Tension via Supergravity

evidence.text: Can supergravity reconcile a positive canonical inflationary potential with a non-positive potential used in the de Sitter conjectures? The proposed construction separates these potentials through an overall sign reversal of a superconformal scalar-gravity action.

sources.title: Two-Field Quintessential Higgs Model and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does an inflationary extension of an exponentially coupled Higgs–quintessence potential satisfy the stated de Sitter Swampland conjecture while agreeing with CMB observables, and can it retain the previously proposed Higgs-stability mechanism?

sources.title: Exploring the Parameter Space of Inflation Model on the Brane and its Compatibility with the Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can inverse monomial inflation on a brane produce suitable inflationary observables while satisfying refined de Sitter, further-refined de Sitter, scalar weak gravity and strong scalar weak gravity conjectures?

sources.title: A multiverse outside of the swampland

evidence.text: Can inflation populate a multiverse that scans the cosmological constant and weak scale while satisfying distance and refined de Sitter conjectures, even without de Sitter minima? If de Sitter minima are allowed, is eternal inflation necessary?

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and the Refined Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can eternal inflation near a single-field potential maximum coexist with the refined de Sitter conjecture? The comparison concerns a tachyonic hilltop branch that avoids the original positive-gradient requirement.

sources.title: Phenomenological Consequences of the Refined Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Does the conjecture constrain each metastable inflationary branch or only the lowest-energy branch? The source leaves this choice unresolved for pure natural inflation.

sources.title: Two-field inflationary model and swampland de Sitter conjecture

evidence.text: The conjectures are introduced as proposed restrictions on inflationary effective theories compatible with quantum gravity. The distance criterion concerns field variation, while the de Sitter criterion concerns a normalized potential slope.

sources.title: Swampland de Sitter conjectures in no-scale supergravity models

evidence.text: Which parameter choices make toy no-scale supergravity de Sitter models compatible with the refined de Sitter conjecture (RdSC) and trans-Planckian censorship conjecture (TCC), and can added rolling fields stabilize the no-scale sector while retaining conjecture compatibility?

sources.title: Generalizing the swampland: Embedding $P(X, \varphi)$ inflationary theories in a curved multifield space

evidence.text: Can a slowly evolving P(X,ϕ) inflationary background have a sufficiently steep potential in this curved two-field extension to meet the de Sitter gradient conjecture?

sources.title: Inflation and de Sitter conjectures in 8-dimensional $R+γR^n$ Gravity

evidence.text: How do single-field and two-field inflationary potentials obtained from eight-dimensional higher-curvature gravity perform against the paper's cited inflationary constraints and original, refined, and further-refined de Sitter conjectures?
